SABOTEUR (Durell 1985) - D64 build: BOOT + one LOAD_ORG file (SAB-HIGH). No code runs from $D000+ at load time.
Spine: SYSTEM INIT -> MACRO LOADER (SAB_DISK / SAB_HIGH -> $E000) -> START GAME -> TITLE_STUB $9F60 -> GAME_START $7800.
GAME_START copies $E000-$EFFF to RAM $D000-$DFFF, $01=$25 (no ROMs), own vectors at $FFFA (NMI/RESET $783A, IRQ $9000).
ASSETS (editable):
 SAB_OBJECTS  BMP_OBJECTS $0900-$2B99  the 44 software-sprite frames (player + guard), graphics + masks. Sizes live at $6EEF/$6F1B.
 SAB_ROOMS    MAP_DATA RLE ROOMS $3445  121 rooms 30x17 (11x11 grid, room 0 top-left). Painted with SAB_TILES.
 SAB_PROPS    BMP_OBJECTS $5B1A-$644D  the 37 room props (crates, doors, helicopter cockpit...). Sizes live at $644E/$6473.
 SAB_ROOMS object layer: per-room prop placements -> pointer table $6720 + lists $6812-$6D2C (spill $08C0-$08FF). O = object mode in the map editor.
 SAB_TILES    CHAR_SET $F000  editor-only view of the 111 room tiles (game tiles: pointers $C400, colours $C4DE).
 SAB_HIGH     BYTE_DATA $E000  sprite/props data + end-of-game routine (runs at $D400 after the copy).
Code: GAME CODE 1-4 $6D2D-$8BFF, IRQ+SYSTEM 1-3 $9000-$9FFF, TABLES + CODE C000. Data: GFX TABLES $2B9A, PROP GFX $572B, title $8C00/$A000.
Not in BOOT: $CC00-$FFFF (built at runtime / loaded from disk).
